arpa.description: Revenue per customer per month in year 1.

churn.description: The share of customers at the start of a month who leave in it, as a fraction.

collection.description: When a month's revenue is collected; together 100%, else ⚠.

customers.description: Paying customers at the start; may have one decimal.

new_customers.description: New customers in the first month; may have one decimal.

new_growth.description: Monthly growth of new customers, as a fraction.

price_increase.description: The yearly increase of ARPA, as a fraction.

services.description: Services revenue in the first month.

services_growth.description: Monthly growth of services, as a fraction.
